proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationOverride
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation + charge-cast surface can express casting a named spell, but it cannot express that the item's chosen face fixes the spell's destination plane for that cast.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.keyed_plane_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The item chooses among pre-keyed cube faces, and the selected face must propagate into the granted spell cast as a constrained destination rather than an unconstrained spell parameter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_cubic_gate.dhall. Top-level fit exists as a magic-item activation with a charge pool and dawn recharge, but the current surface cannot honestly encode the keyed-plane destination parameter on Gate and Plane Shift casts.
